## Interfaces

`contract/project-design.json` lists optional work-item `size` with enum `XS`, `S`, `M`, `L`, `XL` and optional `estimate_minutes` with no enum. The phase payload is still `title`, `ordinal`, and `effort`. `skills/plan-phase/SKILL.md` example payloads use `"size": "M"` and `"estimate_minutes": 25`, and `M` is in that enum. `25` is a JSON number. The skill says the phase record stores neither field. `tests/test_skill_contract_consistency.py` passed with both files present (127 tests passed together with the new contract and skill tests, the plan wave and trace tests, and contract self-consistency).

## Assumptions

`estimate_minutes` stays a free field because the runtime has no integer type. The skill, not the contract, states that it is a non-negative integer. Tasks in one wave still share one executor. Old work-items omit both fields.

## Invariants

Absent `estimate_minutes` is not stored as zero. `size` and `estimate_minutes` are independent. The sitting line remains `one sitting` or `more than one` on the phase body. There is no `minutes` field and no `hours` field. Neither task edited `dashboard/`.

## Conflicts

none
